changes.title: Species calls
items: Every kind of creature has its own call in its chatter: birds chirp and trill (the owl hoots), wolves and foxes bark and howl when angered, big beasts grunt and bellow, small ones squeak, bugs buzz and click, the snake hisses, toads croak, bats squeak, otters and beavers whistle

changes.title: Whale song
items: Legends sing like whales: long, deep, slow moans in a huge space; calm and rising when happy, groaning low when angry, wavering in a nightmare, and one long building swell before their big attack
A sleeping legend moans softly in its dreams now and then as you pass

changes.title: Babble
items: Animals talk when they attack: a burst of babble in their own voice, squeaky for small young ones and rumbling for big adults and legends; happy ones chirp, enraged ones snap and snarl, wild ones grumble
Creatures turning angry or happy say so in their own voice
Your 💌s will be your witch chattering away, each burst a little phrase lifting at the end, as soon as they land
